about: HEAT AND THE HUNT (Dom 2026-10-28, ported from Armagedom's wanted tally and marked hunters, docs/hunter-port.md). HEAT is a number that rises with every kill and cools while the hero rests. Session only: it lives in memory, is never saved and never sent (the save string is byte for byte the same with or without it), a reload starts cold, and the hero's death sets it to 0. `maxHeat` is the ceiling. `gain`: what raises it. V3 has only bosses, so each boss kill adds `kill` (a hunter killed too); each star of the boss killed adds `perStar` (data/stars.json); a boss of a biome ring adds the ring's number in `ring` (data/rings.json ring ids; a ring with no row adds 0); and the kill coins (data/corpse-run.json) count too: every `coinsPerHeat` coins earned add 1 (the remainder carries over). `decay.secondsPerMark`: with no kill for that long the heat drops by 1, then by 1 more every further period. `tiers`: from `minHeat` up the hero is at that tier (ascending, the first at 1). A tier's `timeScale` multiplies every hunt wait (never below hunt.minSeconds), `hunters` is how many hunters may be after him at once (never past hunt.maxHunters), `stars` the chance each new hunter arrives as a 1- or 2-star boss (data/stars.json levels; the chances add up to at most 1). THE HUNT (src/zone/hunters.ts): while he has heat, a hunter (profile `hunt.kind`, data/profiles.json: the Executioner's archetype, PLACEHOLDER body Gargantua's) is announced, `warningSeconds` later arrives `spawnDistanceMetres` behind him (never within `campClearMetres` plus the camp's aggro of a standing boss) and walks straight at him at `speedMetresPerSecond` (his walk is 3, his run 5.2, so he can outrun it). Once it is within its `aggro` of him it is an ordinary boss: the existing aggro hand-over starts the 1v1, or, if he is already fighting, it joins as an attacker (the world's maxAttackers still caps it). Past `giveUpMetres` it loses him and goes. The waits: `arrivalDelaySeconds` after the heat first rises, `spawnCooldownSeconds` between two arrivals, `respawnDelaySeconds` after one is killed or loses him, all scaled by the tier. The hunter's slots are parked rows in the zone's spawn list (`parkedSeconds`: they never respawn on their own timer). The hunter's health and damage ride the same escalation as every boss (data/progression.json), nothing extra. `hud`: the one small line under the coin line and the unlock line (so the two never overlap), plain DOM text, written only when the count changes (no canvas, no texture, no per-frame work). `lines`: the three plain HUD lines. No URL flag: it is on, and every number is a row, checked by src/heat.ts validateHeat and test/heat.test.mjs.

lines.warning: A hunter is on your trail
